quarterly_data.quarter: Novo Nordisk press release: Highlights to be presented at Novo's Capital Markets Day (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At its Capital Markets Day in London, Novo set strategic ambitions for 2030 (by 2030 from a 2026 baseline; the company states they do not constitute its financial outlook or guidance): launch >5 multi-blockbusters by 2030 and deliver >150 bDKK risk-adjusted pipeline sales in 2035; enter or complete ≥ 5 Phase 3 programmes in obesity and diabetes and ≥ 5 in other therapy areas; deliver 2026-30 revenue CAGR in line with industry peers (Eli Lilly, AstraZeneca, Roche and others named); scale capacity to be able to serve 10x more people with obesity on oral GLP-1; serve >60m patients globally by 2030; maintain a broadly stable operating margin and an attractive dividend per share (adjusted metrics).
quarterly_data.figure: >5 multi-blockbusters by 2030; >150 bDKK pipeline sales in 2035; ≥ 5 + ≥ 5 Phase 3 programmes; capacity for 10x more oral GLP-1 obesity patients; >60m patients by 2030
